plain_summary_en: This paper studies “It’s Your Choice to Make”: Deontic Inversion as a Practice for Handling Conflicting Grounds for Decision Making. In plain terms, it asks what is happening, why it matters for public communication, and what evidence the authors use. The likely focus is For, Your, Choice, Make. The abstract suggests a mixed methods approach, which makes the work useful for understanding how communication changes in everyday life.
